data.long_meaning: Aminul is a name derived from the Arabic language, meaning 'Reliable' or 'Trustworthy'. In Islamic tradition, it is considered a spiritual name, symbolizing faith, honesty, and righteousness. The name Aminul carries the meaning “Reliable, Trustworthy” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Aminul usually hope their child will grow to embody reliable, trustworthy and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbol of trustworthiness and faith in God
data.etymology: Aminul belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Reliable, Trustworthy.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Aminul total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

They are the ones who believe in the Oneness of Allah, and the Prophethood of Muhammad, and the Holy Quran, and they work to establish the correct foundations of Islam in their lives, and to spread the message of Islam to others, and to work for the betterment of the Ummah. They are the ones who believe in the hereafter, and the accountability of their actions, and they work to live a life of righteousness, and to avoid the evil deeds, and to work for the betterment of the society.
